classification.difficultyReason: Identify each labelled side relative to the marked angle in differently oriented triangles, then match the side pair to SOH CAH TOA; no calculation or further inference is required.

content.prompt: Label the given sides then decide the appropriate ratio that relates the two sides.

spec.description: Right angle at lower left; theta at lower right; vertical leg 4 and hypotenuse 9. Supplied answer annotations are omitted from the question figure.
spec.mathematics: 4 is opposite and 9 is the hypotenuse relative to theta.
spec.answerVisibility: Side classifications and selected ratio appear only in answers.

answer.worked:
The side of length $4$ is opposite $\theta$ and the side of length $9$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\sin\theta=\frac{\mathrm{Opp}}{\mathrm{Hyp}}=\frac49$$
Correct answer: sin.

spec.description: Right angle at lower left and theta at lower right; vertical leg 6, base 7.

answer.worked:
$6$ is opposite and $7$ is adjacent to $\theta$.
$$\tan\theta=\frac{\mathrm{Opp}}{\mathrm{Adj}}=\frac67$$
Correct answer: tan.
